firm_data.firm_description: Campolo, Middleton & McCormick, LLP is a premier law firm with offices across Long Island. Recently recognized as one of America’s Top Trusted Corporate Law Firms by Forbes, CMM has become the firm of choice for clients with respect to their most significant business transactions, challenging legal issues, and critical disputes.
notable_facts: Recognized as one of America’s Top Trusted Corporate Law Firms by Forbes
Offices on the East End and in Nassau County

email.subject: AI for Campolo, Middleton & McCormick, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Joseph,

Congratulations on CMM's Forbes recognition as one of America's Top Trusted Corporate Law Firms. That reputation for handling significant transactions and critical disputes is exactly why we're reaching out.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Long Island area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Ronkonkoma office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
